results.name: M1399 Bulldog High Mobile Light Artillery

results.name: Zorawar LT
results.description:
The Zorawar is an Indian light tank design. It is designed to have a high power-to-weight ratio along with substantial firepower, protection, surveillance and communication capabilities. It was designed to provide the Indian Army with the versatility to execute operations in varying terrain against diverse threats and equipment profiles of its adversaries. The Zorawar is armed with a 105mm NATO cannon, 12.7mm heavy machine mounted in a remote weapons station, a 7.62mm coaxial machine gun, and a launcher for two SPIKE anti-tank missiles. The Zorawar can be extended with multimission module that allows it to deploy a UAV and loiter munitions. It can also use the NIRMA Anti-tank missile system in place of the 105mm cannon.

Learn more at  https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: ZTQ-15 Black Panther Light Tank 式轻型坦克
results.description:
Type 15 (Chinese: 15式轻型坦克; ZTQ-15), nicknamed the Black Panther is a Chinese third-generation light tank. Designed for combat in extreme temperatures the Type 15 has been adopted by the Chinese Marines and Chinese Army as the ZTQ-15. The main gun is a 105mm rifled gun and the first designed to fire standard NATO 105mm ammunition with a 38-round autoloader.  It is also armed with a 35mm automatic grenade launcher, a 7.62mm coaxial machine gun, and a remotely controlled 12.7mm heavy machine gun. The Type-15 can also fire GP105mm guided missiles out to a range of 5km. The Type 15 has advanced optics and thermal imaging which gives it superior night fighting and long-range engagement up to 8km. It's also equipped with laser warning, NBC, air conditioning, smoke, and fire suppression systems.  The ZTQ-15 is able to be rapidly deployed and fight in high mountains and coastlines

Learn more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: Beaverhawk - tank
results.description:
The *Beaverhawk I* was a secret heavy tank developed by the Canadian Army in the early 1940s, as part of a contingency plan in the event of an invasion from south of the 49th parallel during World War II. Designed to defend Canada’s vast, rugged terrain, the *Beaverhawk I* was built to withstand both the harsh northern conditions and any potential American assault.
Weighing 95 tons, the *Beaverhawk I* was heavily armored, with up to 200mm of steel on its front hull. Its primary armament was a 105mm gun, mounted in a fully rotating turret capable of handling various terrain, from dense forests to icy tundra. The tank’s suspension system was specially engineered for maximum durability, incorporating oversized tracks for stability in snow and mud.
Only two prototypes were produced, and the project was quietly shelved after the war. Official records about the tank remain scarce, though declassified documents confirm its existence and development as a defensive measure against a potential invasion.

results.name: M6A2E1
results.description:
M6A2E1 – Uparmored T1E1 fitted with a new turret with a T5E1 105 mm gun. Used for testing T29 heavy tank project armament system.

M6A2E1 – with thicker (equivalent to 7.5-inch (190 mm) vertical protection) glacis armor and a turret developed for the T29 Heavy Tank, armed with a T5E1 105 mm gun but no increase in engine power. Ordnance believed they could be delivered by November. The proposal was put to the supreme commander in Europe General Eisenhower, who rejected them as impracticable. Two tanks were used to test the T29 turret and gun, but their armor was not modified.

results.name: SMS Geier
results.description: SMS Geier was an unprotecte cruiser built for the Imperial German navy in 1893, and later came under American control during the midd stage of ww1 when she was interned in Hawaii at the beginning of the war. She was laid down in 1893 and launched a year later before entering service in 1895. The ship was designed to operate overseas in German colonies and to protect those colonies, and so came with an armament of 105mm guns, but no armour and a top speed of 15 knots, which in later years proved to be fairly slow. She was sunk in June 1918 by a collision with a freighter off the coast of North Carolina where shee rests to this day, albeit the wreck is not in good condition.

results.name: Nikon AF-S DX Nikkor 18-105mm f/3.5-5.6G ED VR
results.description:
•	Let me present to you simple-quality low-poly 3D model Nikon AF-S DX Nikkor 18-105mm f/3.5-5.6G ED VR Lens. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real lens that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.

•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.

•	The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.

•	Polygon count of the model is – 1063.

•	The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale. All parts grouped and named correctly.

•	To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).

Note: If you see some artifacts on the textures, it means compression works in the Viewer. We recommend setting HD quality for textures. But anyway, original textures have no artifacts.

results.name: Pittsburgh Class Heavy Cruiser

Size: 282m (Length), 28.3m (Width), 7.8m (Draft).

Armament: 12x 230mm/56 inch caliber guns (4x3). 10x 130mm/40 inch caliber guns DP (8x2). 32x 76mm M55 Skysweepers (16x2). 14x 25mm Autocannons (14x1) 24x 25mm Autocannons (12x2).

Armour: 205mm main belt, 120mm upper and lower belts. Deck 105mm. Turrets 254mm front, 128mm sides. Barbettes 185mm. Conning tower 203mm.

Propulsion: 4 shafts, 10 boilers, Vertical Electric turbines. 185,000 shp.

Crew: 1625 crew, 50 officers.

Speed: 36.5 knots. Can push to 41.5 knots for 3 hours if needed.

Service time: 1957+

Date of Construction: 1957.

Range: 12,500 nmi at 18 knots.

Number Built: 28.

Enjoy!
